May contain spoilers from Sky King's Tomb **Source** [Pathfinder #193: Mantle of Gold](/Sources.aspx?ID=206) pg. 84 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- This _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [clan dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=13)_ bears the face of a stern dwarven god, his beard and features forming part of the blade. Forming the Bond The PCs complete the [rite of repatriation](/Rituals.aspx?ID=105).
**Advancing the Bond** Protect, recover, and restore dwarven culture and people.
**Minor Gifts** [deadly spark](/Relics.aspx?ID=1), [divine retribution](/Relics.aspx?ID=13),[ word of faith](/Relics.aspx?ID=15); divine retribution Strikes made with Skysunder gain the deadly d4 trait.
**Major Gifts** [holy light](/Relics.aspx?ID=16), [propelling winds](/Relics.aspx?ID=5)
name: Skysunder
